sentences.text:
This bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 362 of 2019, under
Sections- 498A, 304B, 120B Ipc and Section-3/4 of D. P. Act, police station Akbarpur, District
Kanpur Nagar, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel appearing for the applicant, learned counsel for informant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.

The allegation that the deceased was being harassed on account Pushpendra Singh Yadav @ Bahadur vs State Of U.P. on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60439557/
1 of dowry, is wholly false.

entities.text: Pushpendra Singh Yadav @ Bahadur vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was submitted that the deceased has sustained injuries accidentally by falling from the roof.
After the incident the applicant has got admitted the deceased to hospital.
Lastly it was stated that the applicant is languishing in jail since 1.8.2019, having no criminal history, and that in case he is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.

4. Learned A. G. A. as well as learned counsel for informant have opposed the application and submitted that as per prosecution version, the deceased was being harassed on account of dowry and that she was pushed from the roof and resultantly, she has sustained six injuries and deceased has died of ante-mortem injuries.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.

6. Accordingly, this bail application moved on behalf of the applicant Pushpendra Singh Yadav @
Bahadur is rejected.

7. However, considering the period of detention of the applicant, concerned trial court is directed to expedite the trial and conclude the same as early as possible, preferably within a period of nine months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
